BackDown 1.0.0-beta.9

The ninth beta of BackDown 1.0: a reliability fix, nothing else. The release notes of BackDown 1.0.0-beta.9, with its downloads and checksums.

On this page
  • Install
  • What's fixed since beta.8
  • Known limitations

Released 2026-11-09 · downloads and checksums on GitHub · Download page The ninth beta of BackDown 1.0: a reliability fix, nothing else.

A long index run — including the one-time names index that beta.7/beta.8 build the first time they open a big index — committed its work in safely bounded batches, but never reclaimed the space those batches left behind in the index's write-ahead log. On an idle reader (even one just sitting on an old snapshot) and a big enough drive, that log could grow without bound instead of shrinking back down: on one 27-million-file index it grew past 47 GB and filled the disk. BackDown now reclaims that space as it goes — after every batch, when the index opens, and between jobs — so upgrading from any earlier beta, even on a very large index, no longer carries that risk.

Install#

PlatformInstallerCommand line
Linux x86-64backdown-io_1.0.0-beta.9_amd64.deb (Debian, Ubuntu) or .AppImagebackdown-v1.0.0-beta.9-linux-x86_64.tar.gz (static)
Linux ARM64backdown-io_1.0.0-beta.9_arm64.deb or .AppImagebackdown-v1.0.0-beta.9-linux-arm64.tar.gz (static)
macOS (Apple silicon + Intel)BackDown-1.0.0-beta.9.dmgbackdown-v1.0.0-beta.9-macos-universal.tar.gz

Windows builds are paused for this beta while the port is finished; follow it at https://github.com/BuenGenio/BackDown/issues/94.

This release is signed. SHA256SUMS.txt.sig is an Ed25519 signature of SHA256SUMS.txt by BackDown's release key, and backdown update checks it before installing anything. To check by hand, see Air-gapped computers.

The installers and apps themselves still aren't signed by Apple. On macOS, right-click the app and choose Open the first time (for the command-line binary: xattr -d com.apple.quarantine backdown).

What's fixed since beta.8#

  • The index's write-ahead log is now reclaimed as a long job runs (every batch commit, during the names-index build, between a folder's scans), when the index opens (so a WAL left big by an earlier run or a crash doesn't carry forward), and once between jobs while the service is otherwise idle.
  • Nothing else changed: beta.8's places, search and tagging are exactly as they were.

Known limitations#

  • Reverse-geocoding is to the nearest populated place of 1,000+ people; a photo far from any town takes the nearest one, with lower confidence. The named-place and airport matches are within a set distance.
  • The name index takes some room: on 8.5 million distinct names, about 1.2 GB.
  • Searching another machine at its fastest needs beta.7 or later there too.
  • The installers aren't signed or notarised by Apple.
  • Windows builds are paused this beta while the port is finished (#94); Linux and macOS are unaffected.
  • Pro, Team and Forensic features are free during the beta; pricing may change before 1.0.

Documentation: https://backdown.io/docs/. Provided as-is, without warranty, for evaluation.
